title: MOVE ONLINE recommended on 12.1, where it does not exist
expected_feedback: Critical: ALTER TABLE MOVE rewrites all 30M rows under an exclusive lock, blocking DML for the duration and leaving every index UNUSABLE (ORA-01502) afterwards. The standard mitigation, MOVE ONLINE, was introduced in 12.2 — this database is 12.1, so it does not exist here even though the edition is Enterprise. This is exactly why Gate 1 records the release rather than the family: 'Oracle 12c' would have hidden the distinction and produced a plan that fails at parse time. On 12.1 EE use DBMS_REDEFINITION, or CTAS plus a quiesced two-step cutover. Whichever is chosen, schedule the index rebuilds explicitly — a non-online MOVE does not maintain them.
violated_rule: Version-gated mitigations must be checked against the exact release
